vector_memory.semantic_summary: RapierBackend provides a concrete implementation of the PhysicsBackend interface using the @dimforge/rapier3d-compat library. It acts as a service provider, managing the lifecycle of the physics world by wrapping the Rapier module. It exposes methods to initialize the backend, create physics worlds, and manage rigid bodies and colliders within the simulation environment. The implementation handles complex shape translations and simulation stepping via the RapierWorld class.
